experiment_data.hypothesis: Hard filtering (detect-and-remove) at q_score > 0.5 threshold discards contaminated samples and trains uniformly on remaining clean data. Expected to underperform adaptive weighting because it wastes information from borderline samples and the binary threshold is miscalibrated relative to the soft q_score distribution.
